# Plan — 2026-07-26

## Context

Today's research scan (2026-07-26) produced **zero new actionable items**. All commits from Kilocode, Cline, and OpenCode are non-portable (remote-relay advertising, VS Code/desktop-app specific features, SDK migration cleanup, UI polish).

However, the research brief identifies **11 carry-forward items** from previous research cycles (2026-07-17 through 2026-07-22). This planning run will prioritize the most valuable carry-forward items and create GitHub issues for immediate implementation.

## Prioritization

From the carry-forward backlog, prioritizing by Value/Effort ratio:

### High Priority (create issues today)

1. **Optional tree-sitter grammars** (2026-07-22 #2, MODERATE, ~4h, deps)
   - Saves ~67MB install size (~14% of node_modules)
   - Move tree-sitter-typescript, tree-sitter-javascript, tree-sitter-bash to optionalDependencies
   - Lazy-load in `src/context/treeSitter.ts`, fallback to regex extractor
   - **Files**: `package.json`, `src/context/treeSitter.ts`, `src/tool/tools/definitions.ts`
   - **Tests**: `tests/context/treeSitter.test.ts`, `tests/tool/tools/definitions.test.ts`

2. **Stalled-stream watchdog** (2026-07-22 #1, MODERATE, ~5h, tool)
   - Prevents hung sessions when SAP AI Core streams stall mid-turn
   - Replace async generator with hand-rolled AsyncIterator (return() runs immediately)
   - Add tool-aware idle timeout (long-running tools extend window)
   - **Files**: `src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts`, `src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts`
   - **Tests**: `tests/core/streamingOrchestrator.test.ts`

3. **Custom file extension handlers** (2026-07-18 #1, MODERATE, ~3h, tool)
   - Support non-standard file extensions via configuration
   - Allow users to map `.env.local`, `.eslintrc.cjs`, etc. to known handlers
   - **Files**: `src/tool/tools/read.ts`, `src/tool/tools/edit.ts`, `src/config/index.ts`
   - **Tests**: `tests/tool/tools/read.test.ts`, `tests/tool/tools/edit.test.ts`

4. **Shell resolution rationalization** (2026-07-21 #3, MODERATE, ~3h, tool)
   - Detect user shell (SHELL env var → ~/.bashrc/.zshrc) and surface in bash tool
   - Prevents 'command not found' for tools in user PATH
   - **Files**: `src/tool/tools/bash.ts`, `src/tool/tools/shell.ts`
   - **Tests**: `tests/tool/tools/bash.test.ts`

5. **Bash tree-sitter tag extraction** (2026-07-20 #1, MODERATE, ~4h, tool)
   - Extract function definitions from bash scripts using tree-sitter-bash
   - Powers definitions tool for shell scripts
   - **Files**: `src/context/treeSitter.ts`, `src/tool/tools/definitions.ts`
   - **Tests**: `tests/context/treeSitter.test.ts`

### Medium Priority (defer for now)

6. **OAuth token refresh** (2026-07-21 #2, HIGH, ~6h, provider)
   - Conditional on SAP AI Core token lifecycle (needs auth research)

7. **Remote slash commands** (2026-07-17 #1, HIGH, ~5h, tool)
   - Conditional on Alexi adopting remote relay architecture (not planned)

8. **Auto-CA certificate harvesting** (2026-07-17 #2, HIGH, ~6h, provider)
   - Conditional on enterprise proxy environments (needs user signal)

### Low Priority (defer for now)

9. **Context overflow patterns** (2026-07-20 #3, LOW, ~2h, core)
10. **Sidebar usage metrics** (2026-07-18 #3, LOW, ~2h, core)
11. **Document subagent depth** (2026-07-17 #5, LOW, ~1h, core)

- **Why**: Business value / user impact
- **How**: Specific files to modify, implementation approach
- **Done when**: Objective acceptance criteria (tests pass, coverage >= 40%)
